test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Data Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System continuously monitors temperature in GMP storage areas and records readings at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational in all GMP storage areas.
System access credentials are available.

test_steps.action: Access the Environmental Monitoring System interface and navigate to the real-time monitoring dashboard for a designated GMP storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The system displays real-time temperature readings for the selected storage area.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the real-time monitoring dashboard.

test_steps.action: Observe the temperature readings for a period of at least 10 minutes, noting the timestamps of each recorded reading.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are continuously updated and recorded at intervals of 5 minutes or less.
data_to_capture: Log of observed temperature readings with timestamps.
System log showing data recording timestamps.

acceptance_criteria: The system successfully displays continuous real-time temperature readings.
All recorded temperature data points have timestamps that are within 5 minutes of each other.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be recorded accurately with correct timestamps.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range, Accuracy, and Alarm Deviation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System operates within the specified temperature range (-80°C to +50°C) with the required accuracy (±0.5°C) and generates alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational.
A known temperature source (e.g., calibrated thermometer, environmental chamber) is available.
System access credentials are available.
A setpoint for a GMP storage area is defined and configured in the system.

test_steps.action: Place a calibrated reference thermometer alongside a system temperature sensor in a GMP storage area. Record the system's reported temperature and the reference thermometer's reading.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's reported temperature is within ±0.5°C of the reference thermometer's reading.

test_steps.action: Adjust the environmental conditions (or use a controlled temperature source) to simulate a temperature deviation of +2°C from the configured setpoint for a GMP storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates an alert notification indicating a temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: System log entry for the alert.

test_steps.action: Adjust the environmental conditions (or use a controlled temperature source) to simulate a temperature deviation of -2°C from the configured setpoint for a GMP storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates an alert notification indicating a temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: System log entry for the alert.

test_steps.action: Verify that the system can accurately report temperatures across its specified range by testing at or near the extreme ends (e.g., -75°C and +45°C) using a calibrated source.
test_steps.expected_result: The system reports temperatures within the specified range (-80°C to +50°C) with the required accuracy.
data_to_capture: System reported temperatures at extreme points.
Reference thermometer readings at extreme points.

acceptance_criteria: Temperature readings are accurate within ±0.5°C compared to a calibrated reference.
The system generates an alert when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
The system can accurately monitor and report temperatures within the -80°C to +50°C range.
data_integrity_requirements: Temperature readings must be accurate and within specified tolerances.
Alerts must be generated promptly and accurately upon deviation.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor-Supplied Software Unmodified and Data Storage
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system uses vendor-supplied software without modification and that data is stored in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Access to EMS system software files and database.

test_steps.action: Access the EMS system's software installation directory and compare the installed files with the original vendor-supplied installation media or checksums.
test_steps.expected_result: All installed software files match the vendor-supplied originals and show no signs of modification.

test_steps.action: Query the EMS database to identify the format of stored temperature and humidity data.
test_steps.expected_result: The stored data is in the vendor's standard database format as documented by the vendor.

acceptance_criteria: All EMS software files are confirmed to be unmodified vendor-supplied versions.
The format of stored environmental data is verified to be the vendor's standard database format.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-003: The system shall use vendor-supplied software without modification.
URS-EMS-006: All data shall be stored in the vendor's standard database format.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in a format that ensures its integrity and is retrievable.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Alarm Notification and Response Time
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system generates alerts when temperature deviates from setpoint and that the system response time for alarm conditions does not exceed 30 seconds.
prerequisites: EMS system is operational and monitoring temperature.
Alarm setpoints are configured.
Site paging system is accessible and configured for integration.
Access to EMS system logs and notification history.

test_steps.action: Manually adjust a temperature sensor in a monitored area to a value that is 2°C above or below the configured setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm is triggered by the EMS system.

test_steps.action: Record the time from when the temperature deviation occurred (as per step 1) to when the alarm notification is received by the site paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: The total response time for the alarm condition (from deviation to notification) is less than or equal to 30 seconds.

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification received by the site paging system contains accurate information about the alarm (e.g., location, temperature value, deviation).
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm notification is accurate and contains all relevant details.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS system successfully triggers an alarm when temperature deviates by ±2°C from the setpoint.
The system response time for alarm conditions, from temperature deviation to notification receipt, is within 30 seconds.
Alarm notifications are accurate and contain relevant details.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-005: The system shall generate alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from setpoint.
URS-EMS-015: Alarm notifications shall integrate with site paging system using vendor API.
URS-EMS-011: System response time shall not exceed 30 seconds for alarm conditions.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm events must be accurately logged and time-stamped.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Audit Trail and Electronic Signature Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system generates and maintains a comprehensive audit trail and supports electronic signatures as per 21 CFR Part 11.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
A simulated event requiring an audit trail entry (e.g., configuration change, alarm acknowledgment) is planned.

test_steps.action: Perform a configuration change within the EMS system (e.g., adjust a setpoint).
test_steps.expected_result: An audit trail entry is created, recording the user, date, time, action performed, and the old and new values.

test_steps.action: Acknowledge an active alarm condition using an electronic signature.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts for and captures a valid electronic signature, and the acknowledgment is recorded in the audit trail with the signature details.
data_to_capture: Audit trail log entry for alarm acknowledgment

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail report generated by the vendor's standard reporting functionality.
test_steps.expected_result: The report accurately reflects all recorded events, including the simulated configuration change and alarm acknowledgment, with all required 21 CFR Part 11 elements present.

acceptance_criteria: All audit trail entries are complete, accurate, and timestamped.
Electronic signatures are captured and linked to the relevant actions.
The audit trail report contains all required information for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must be secure, unalterable, and time-stamped.
Electronic signatures must be unique, attributable, and linked to the record.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Archival and Retention Capabilities
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can archive historical data and retain it for the required 7-year period using the vendor's archival feature.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists to test archival (or simulated data can be generated).
Archival destination is configured and accessible.

test_steps.action: Initiate the archival process for a defined period of historical data (e.g., 1 year of data).
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully archives the selected data to the designated archival location.
data_to_capture: Archived data file location and size

test_steps.action: Verify the integrity of the archived data by attempting to retrieve a sample of records.
test_steps.expected_result: The retrieved data matches the original data, and the integrity of the archived dataset is confirmed.

test_steps.action: Simulate the passage of time or adjust system clocks to verify the 7-year retention policy is enforced (if applicable to the archival feature's management).
test_steps.expected_result: The system correctly manages data retention according to the 7-year requirement, potentially flagging data for deletion or preventing deletion of active data.
data_to_capture: System logs related to data retention

test_steps.action: Verify that the system's standard reports can access and display data from the archived location if required for batch release.
test_steps.expected_result: Reports can successfully query and display data from the archived dataset.
data_to_capture: Sample reports generated from archived data

acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully archived to the specified location.
Archived data integrity is maintained.
The system demonstrates adherence to the 7-year retention policy.
Archived data is accessible for reporting purposes.
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must be secure, unalterable, and retrievable.
Retention periods must be strictly enforced.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Reports for Batch Release and Data Storage Format
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system utilizes vendor-provided standard reports for batch release and stores data in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Access to system reports and database logs is available.

test_steps.action: Access the reporting module of the EMS system and generate a standard report typically used for batch release.
test_steps.expected_result: A standard report, as provided by the vendor, is successfully generated and displays relevant environmental monitoring data.

test_steps.action: Examine the system's database configuration or consult system documentation to confirm the data storage format.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's data is stored in the vendor's specified standard database format (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, proprietary format).

acceptance_criteria: The generated report is identical to the vendor's standard report template.
The system's data storage format is confirmed to be the vendor's standard.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-006: All data shall be stored in the vendor's standard database format.
URS-EMS-007: Standard reports provided by vendor shall be used for batch release.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in a format that ensures its integrity and is compatible with vendor-provided tools.
Reports used for batch release must be accurate and complete as per vendor specifications.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Facility Management System Integration and Paging System Alarm Notification
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system successfully interfaces with the existing facility management system and integrates with the site paging system for alarm notifications.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Facility management system is operational and accessible.
Site paging system is operational and configured to receive notifications.

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature deviation that triggers an alarm condition within the EMS system.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm is generated within the EMS system.

test_steps.action: Observe the facility management system for any corresponding data updates or alerts originating from the EMS.
test_steps.expected_result: The facility management system receives and displays the relevant alarm information or data update from the EMS system.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of facility management system showing EMS data/alert.
Timestamp of data update in facility management system.

test_steps.action: Verify that the site paging system receives an alarm notification triggered by the EMS system.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm notification is sent to and received by the site paging system, alerting designated personnel.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of paging system notification (if available).
Confirmation from personnel receiving the page.

acceptance_criteria: The facility management system accurately reflects the alarm condition from the EMS.
The site paging system successfully receives and displays the alarm notification.
Alarm notifications are sent via the vendor API as specified.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-014: System shall interface with existing facility management system via standard protocols.
URS-EMS-015: Alarm notifications shall integrate with site paging system using vendor API.
data_integrity_requirements: Data exchanged between systems must be accurate and timely to ensure proper response to environmental deviations.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Data Storage Capacity
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System meets the specified availability percentage and can support the required data storage duration.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is installed and operational.
Access to system logs and monitoring tools is available.
Documentation for planned maintenance schedules is accessible.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 30 days) and record any unplanned downtime.
test_steps.expected_result: The total unplanned downtime does not exceed the allowed percentage for 99.5% availability over the monitoring period.

test_steps.action: Review system configuration and available storage to confirm it can support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring data.
test_steps.expected_result: System configuration and storage capacity are confirmed to meet or exceed the 10-year data storage requirement.

acceptance_criteria: System availability is 99.5% or higher, excluding planned maintenance.
System storage capacity is confirmed to support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring data.
data_integrity_requirements: System uptime is accurately logged and verifiable.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor-Supplied Software Unmodified and Standard Reports
test_cases.objective: To confirm that the Environmental Monitoring System utilizes vendor-supplied software without any modifications and that standard vendor reports are suitable for batch release.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is installed and operational.
Access to system software files and configuration is available.
Examples of standard vendor reports are available for review.

test_steps.action: Verify that no custom modifications have been made to the vendor-supplied software by comparing installed files with vendor-provided checksums or installation media.
test_steps.expected_result: The installed software is identical to the vendor-supplied version, with no unauthorized modifications detected.

test_steps.action: Generate standard reports provided by the vendor for a representative period and review their content and format for suitability for batch release.
test_steps.expected_result: Standard vendor reports contain all necessary data for batch release and are in an acceptable format.

acceptance_criteria: The system software is confirmed to be vendor-supplied and unmodified.
Standard vendor reports are deemed suitable for use in batch release decisions.
data_integrity_requirements: Report data accurately reflects recorded environmental conditions.
